acceptance: Gateway runs record the core platform.gateway{name, routed} block and tpc_compliant=false from core-exec-gateway-capability; get_platform_info adds only adapter-specific details (sanitized host, port, protocol, cache_control slot) and an ExecutionEngineReceipt with the default engine

Per-query queries[].execution_engine uses the shared vocabulary (manifest routes_to names plus unknown), with receipt_source and fallback recorded; DuckDB, Snowflake and unknown buckets are reported separately, never blended

Baseline protection relies on the core variants_comparable guard that core-exec-gateway-capability wires into compare, regression and analytics; this item adds only the adapter fields that guard reads, plus a Snowflake and a Databricks test proving a gateway run from each adapter is excluded from a native baseline set
SHOW WAREHOUSES/CURRENT_REGION probes degrade gracefully (metadata_degraded:true, never IndexError) on empty/truncated/synthetic gateway rows
Cost suppression: cost_estimated null + cost_status not_comparable_gateway in both Snowflake and Databricks normalized metadata when gateway active
context: Plan v2 C1-C5, layered on core-exec-gateway-capability (ADR docs/development/adr/adr-core-execution-variants.md D9). Depends on gw-snowflake-conn, gw-databricks, gw-snowflake-querytag. Run make duplicate-check-delta before adding helpers; reuse the core variants_comparable instead of adding is_native_run. Guardrails: never blend native/gateway numbers; tpc_compliant:false unconditional; sanitize userinfo.
description: Gateway-aware run metadata for both adapters: platform-info gateway block, per-query routing payload with unknown default, wired baseline guard (is_native_run in compare/regression/analytics), hardened metadata probes, wired cost suppression in normalized metadata.
